trace.name: commute
trace.text:
On the way to work

A clean, invigorating autumn breeze sweeps off the bay. You listen to an engaging science podcast that makes the twenty-minute walk feel effortless.

You arrive at the warehouse gate feeling awake and mentally clear.

Arrive at work

trace.name: work
trace.text:
Your shift

Slice tape, fold flaps, slap shipping label, slide tote. You repeat the exact sequence 180 times in two hours. Your heels burn against the sealed concrete. In your pocket, your phone buzzes twice.

You retrieve a fresh pallet of packing supplies from the central cage and restock four neighboring stations with brown tape and packing slips. A routine maintenance task that passes thirty minutes comfortably.

Complete shift
